- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided information about thoracic outlet syndrome (TOS) including symptoms: pain or numbness in the neck, shoulder, arm, or hand; weakness or fatigue in the arm or hand; tingling or burning sensations; swelling or discoloration; headaches or facial pain.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Explained the three main types of TOS: neurogenic TOS, vascular TOS, and mixed TOS.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Discussed potential causes of TOS, including anatomical abnormalities, muscle imbalances, poor posture, trauma, and pregnancy.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Outlined treatment options for TOS, including physical therapy, exercises, pain management, lifestyle changes, and possible surgery.
